title: Coordinate k-planes: dimension k and unit orientations ±e_ι
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and ι : Fin k → Fin P strictly increasing, τ_j := e_{ι(j)} (standard basis vectors of ℝ^P) and V := span{τ_j}. Then dim V = k, and there is a k-vector e (a continuous linear functional on k-covectors) with e(α) = α(τ_0, …, τ_{k−1}) for every k-covector α such that both e and −e are unit orientations of V (IsUnitOrientationOf).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (ι : Fin k → Fin P), StrictMono ι → Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (range (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ) : Fin k → Euclid P))) = k ∧ ∃ e : MultiVector P k, (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, e α = α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ))) ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf e (Submodule.span ℝ (range (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ) : Fin k → Euclid P))) ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (-e) (Submodule.span ℝ (range (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ) : Fin k → Euclid P)))
